feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 7 May 2026 1:05pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 07 May 2026 at 1:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Generally dry and fairly bright with a little sunshine at times, especially in the north and west of the island. Light to moderate south or southwest wind, freshening this evening. Maximum temperature 13°C.

Mainly dry tomorrow with variable amounts of cloud, best of the sunshine likely in the afternoon. Light to moderate south or southwest wind soon veering northwest, top temperature 14°C.


##Outlook##

Generally dry on Saturday with variable amounts of cloud as well as bright or sunny intervals. Moderate to fresh north or northeast wind, strengthening in the evening. Highest temperature 15°C.
